warnings: Axes: x = 1-3 at 4.00 + 4.00 (8.00); y = A-F at 1.50 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 (12.50). Origin A1. Clean CAD vector PDF; every structural and architectural sheet reprints the same chains and they all close.

Rule 4 dummies: x 1' (-1.00) / 3' (9.00) and y A'' (-1.00) / F' (13.50) are the roof overhang edges on A-04 / S-04; x 1'' (2.90) and 2' (5.00) and y A' (-2.10) / B' (3.00) come from the S-02 / A-03 chains; y E' (11.50) is the 1.00 + 1.00 split of E-F on A-04 / S-04. Only 2' (beam B1) and B' (beam B2) and A' / 2' (GS slab edges) carry structural members.
Before-origin dummies share the first main grid's prime sequence: x 1' = -1.00 then 1'' = 2.90; y A' = -2.10 then A'' = -1.00 (reading order top to bottom).

S-03 leader prints 'หลังอะเสระดับ +4.44' for the 150x100x3.2 plate, while the view title and all four elevations / two sections print +4.45 — z_levels takes +4.45 (six sheets against one); +4.44 kept in unassigned_dimensions.

Truss panel chains (S-05: T1 8 x 1.00, T2 1.00 x 6 + 0.90 x 5, T3 1.00 + 1.00), door/window sizes (A-10), footing plan sizes and depths (S-06) and stair risers/treads (S-07) are dimensions inside one element's own detail — kept on those elements, not made into grid lines.
Footing sections reference 'ระดับดินเดิม', which no sheet ties to the ±0.00 road datum — footing depths are not placed on the z axis.
